entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Hear, O God, my voice in my plaint; preserve my life from fear of the enemy:

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, from the tumultuous crowd of the workers of iniquity,

entries.title: Psalms 64:3
segments: Who have sharpened their tongue like a sword, [and] have aimed their arrow, a bitter word;

entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: They encourage themselves in an evil matter, they concert to hide snares; they say, Who will see them?

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They devise iniquities: We have it ready, the plan is diligently sought out. And each one's inward [thought] and heart is deep.

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: ¶But God will shoot an arrow at them: suddenly are they wounded;

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: By their own tongue they are made to fall over one another: all that see them shall flee away.

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: And all men shall fear, and shall declare God's doing; and they shall wisely consider his work.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: The righteous shall rejoice in Jehovah, and trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
